Checks the host public key against the selected account known_hosts file. This does not establish successful SSH authentication or server identity beyond the API result.

Payload status is an optional integer 0/1 flag: 1 means the host exists; 0 means it is absent or must be registered again. failure_type distinguishes new and changed hosts. Payload errors are distinct from UAPI envelope errors; UAPI status=0 remains a failure. Host records, fingerprints and status fields retain optional presence; no nullable fields are inferred.
